label: json-error-split-fallback
description: Shapes where the JSON error-filter split falls back to the row evaluator (more than twice -max-stats-query-series groups), and two within the guard: main vs branch warm p50 (3 runs at 24 h, 5 at 1 h, distinct windows), host proxies against one VictoriaLogs v1.52.0 stack seeded with VictoriaLogs only (8.5 days available, 25 h of window needed), restarts 0->0. Main is origin/main at run time (2410a427), branch is the PR head built before the rebase (7db060e8; the rebase changed no proxy code). Selector {env="production"}, `| json | __error__=""`, [5m], step 5 s at 1 h and 60 s at 24 h. The fallback costs one VictoriaLogs stats scan on top of main's row evaluator; where main's row evaluator fails fast with the series limit error (F1, F2) the branch is slower by that scan.
command: python3 fallback.py <repo> <out> --existing-end <seed end> (host proxies with the shown -max-stats-query-series, a client timeout of 120 s)
